name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Where a page sits: ancestor link cells and a cobalt cell for here; earlier levels fold into a menu by count or width.
whenToUse: Use it to show where a page sits in a hierarchy and link to its ancestors. For an app's own sections use Nav; for switching views of one place use Tabs.

parts.name: Breadcrumb
parts.description: Where this page sits, as cells in one frame: ┌─────────┬──────────┬───┬───────────┬━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │ Network ›│ Europe › │ … │ Rotterdam ›│ ECT Delta (here) ┃ ancestors are link cells; here is cobalt └─────────┴──────────┴───┴───────────┴━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ - The current page is the cobalt cell (location, as in Nav and Tabs), aria-current="page", not a link. - Each ancestor ends in a chevron that mirrors in RTL. Long labels truncate inside their cell; the current page keeps the most room. - Folding: more than `maxItems`, or less than 480px of its own width, folds every ancestor before the parent into a "…" cell whose menu lists them in order. The parent and the page itself always show.

props.name: items
props.description: Ancestors first; the last item is the current page (not a link).

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own 2px frame. cell: a row of an enclosing frame (a panel's or page header's top cell).

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Above this many items the ones before the parent fold into a "…" cell with a menu. Default 4.
